posts.title: Rise of the Product Engineer
posts.description: AI is increasingly enabling technically skilled engineering managers to identify business needs, collaborate with stakeholders, and build features independently. This may drive product and engineering roles to merge within 1.5-3 years, creating AI-native “product engineers.” Success will require broader skills: technical proficiency, business judgment, communication, and stakeholder management. posts.title: What I Learned Building an AI Software Factory
posts.description: The article reflects my journey developing an AI-enhanced workflow called Backlog Loop, which I started to better understand the role of AI and LLMs in software engineering. I cover the limitations of AI, and I advocate for mechanical verification over relying on AI prose. The post What I Learned Building an AI Software Factory first appeared on Code Capsule .

posts.title: What I worry about with AI
posts.description: My reflection on societal isolation amplified by technology and COVID-19, and what to do to foster genuine relationships, critical thinking, and self-awareness to combat loneliness. The post What I worry about with AI first appeared on Code Capsule .
